body.x: Deepscent has introduced ‘Arom’, a smart scent box, in ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT’ (BOOTH # 52843) of CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).

‘Arom’, a scent box, is developed by fusing loT technology with a scent which enables to spread scent in a new method. This product can control the concentration and degree of scent by putting a capsule containing aromatic fragrance into the smart scent box.

A total number of slots for inserting a capsule is four. By connecting the product with a smartphone application, one can control the temperature and change into the different type of fragrance based on personal preference. Based on the season and state of the user, it provides a scent solution that adds emotional sensation into space.
